title: Monostable Flip-Flop
text: Raising edge, falling edge, either edge monostable flip-flop, 1 input, 1 output, {Sample time} sets Block sample time; {Change detection} sets the change in trigger signal, {Initial output} sets the flip-flop initial output and {Pulse duration (s)} sets the output pulse duration. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Change detection
params.values: Change in trigger signal Rising edge (default) | Falling edge | Either edge
